description: Composite tool. Always computes an estimate. When owner_email is also present, the case is accepted on arrival: routed at once to a board-certified specialist near the owner (or held while we match one), and the owner gets a receipt email. Requires X-Agent-Attribution when PII is supplied. When PII is absent, behaves identically to estimate_procedure_cost and returns status="estimate_only".

case_notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes from the owner for the receiving clinic.

city.description: City slug. Optional; helps route to a practice near the owner.

owner_email.description: Optional. When present, submits the quote request (accepted on arrival) and requires X-Agent-Attribution.

owner_name.description: Optional. The email's local part is used if omitted.

state.description: US state code or name. Optional.

name: quote_for_case
